newsitem.title: USA: TU 1,150 MW plant reduces power for repair.
newsitem.headline: TU 1,150 MW plant reduces power for repair.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 was reducing power early Wednesday to 55 percent of capacity for repairs, according to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC).
The unit, in Glen Rose, Texas, was operating at 68 percent of capacity and was reducing to the 55 percent level to "repair inverters," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Company officials could not immediately comment on how long the unit would be operating at the reduced power level.
The adjacent 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 1 continued to operate at full power, the NRC said in the report.
